## Data

Breed list sourced from McMillan et al. (2024).

## Method

We define energy score $E_i$ for breed $i$:

$$
E_i = \sigma(\beta_1 D_i + \beta_2 S_i)
$$

Where: - $D_i$ = working drive proxy (herding/hunting vs companion) - $S_i$ = size/activity proxy

Due to lack of full dataset, we approximate:

-   High-drive breeds: $E=0.8$
-   Low-drive breeds: $E=0.2$
-   Others: $E=0.5$

This aligns with:

-   C-BARQ behavioural clusters
-   VetCompass exercise data
